headline: WNBA Finals Game 2: Dream at Valkyries, 8:00 p.m. ET, series 1-0
whyCareReason: Golden State lead 1-0 after a 68-64 Game 1. Game 2 is Monday at Chase Center. No score is posted.
teaser: USA, Peacock and CNBC. Game 3 is Wednesday in Atlanta if the series continues.
story: Game 2 of the 2026 WNBA Finals is Monday, 19 October, at Chase Center in San Francisco. ESPN and the WNBA list tip at 8:00 p.m. ET on USA Network, Peacock and CNBC. The Atlanta Dream are the visitors. The Golden State Valkyries lead the series 1-0 after Saturday's 68-64 win. Gabby Williams scored 26 points in Game 1. Angel Reese had 14 points and 12 rebounds. The game has not been played. Game 3 is Wednesday, 21 October, at 8:00 p.m. ET at State Farm Arena.
stakes: A second Golden State win would put the Valkyries one win from a 2-0 lead before the series moves to Atlanta. Atlanta need Game 2 to level the series.
rivalryAngle: The higher seed hosts again after taking the first Finals game in franchise history.
